en: -Invasion of the Royal Guards Black Knight Squad that protects the kingdom-

From ``Mobile Suit GundamSEED FREEDOM'' comes mobile suits with the names ``Garnet'', ``Sapphire'', and ``Spinel'' from the emerging nation Foundation Kingdom's SS aircraft ``Black Knight Squad Rudra''.
Equipped with the "SEED Action System" which thoroughly pursues a movable structure that reproduces the poses in the play that are unique to the SEED series!
● Reproduce the characteristic coloring of each aircraft with molded colors
-Reproduce impressive action poses in the "Mobile Suit GundamSEED series"
Equipped with a specialized internal structure "SEED action system".
● Comes with a foil seal that matches each aircraft.
Attached weapons: Anti-mobile suit heavy sword / Seal / High energy beam rifle
Accessories: 1 set of clear sheet/foil seal
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS/PVC
